15	# Draw Paper Figure — 学术图表生成（Worker 执行）
16	
17	Worker 收到画图任务时读本 skill。**画图前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的 L1/L2 原则和 L3 pattern 库。
18	
19	本 skill 提供：
20	- 通用样式（rcParams + 色板）
21	- 三个常用图表的起点模板（reliability/heatmap/scatter）
22	- NeurIPS 经验提炼的 pattern 实现示例
23	
24	## 输入字段（从 Paper Agent 传入）
25	
26	- `fig_id` / `type` / `placement` / `data_source` / `aspect_ratio` / 输出路径
27	- **`narrative_intent`**：一句话，这张图要让读者相信什么
28	- **`design_notes`**：从 paper-visualization L3 选的 pattern 列表
29	
30	## 画图工作流
31	
32	1. 读 paper-visualization skill 的 L1 防丑原则 + L2 叙事原则
33	2. 根据 `narrative_intent` 选起点模板（本 skill §模板）
34	3. 按 `design_notes` 中每个 pattern 添加相应技法（本 skill §pattern 实现）
35	4. 提交前过本 skill §checklist

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Data
qwen_gates = [0.883, 0.793, 0.996, 0.988, 0.984, 0.797, 0.961, 0.918, 0.965, 0.934,
              0.969, 0.918, 0.926, 0.941, 0.930, 0.965, 0.941, 0.910, 0.961, 0.965,
              0.973, 0.988, 0.969, 0.980, 0.980, 0.984, 0.988, 1.000]
llama_gates = [0.957, 0.973, 0.977, 0.965, 0.992, 0.969, 0.957, 0.957, 0.961, 0.949,
               0.938, 0.934, 0.969, 0.953, 0.957, 0.965, 0.953, 0.961, 0.922, 0.902,
               0.883, 0.863, 0.836, 0.844, 0.809, 0.719, 0.762, 0.805, 0.801, 0.855,
               0.898, 0.934]

qwen_arr = np.array(qwen_gates)
llama_arr = np.array(llama_gates)

# Colors: two shades of blue
COLOR_QWEN = '#5B9BD5'   # medium blue
COLOR_LLAMA = '#2E5090'   # dark blue

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 3.5), sharey=True,
                                gridspec_kw={'wspace': 0.08})

# --- Qwen subplot ---
x_q = np.arange(len(qwen_gates))
bars_q = ax1.bar(x_q, qwen_arr, color=COLOR_QWEN, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3, width=0.8)

# Annotate min layers
for idx in np.argsort(qwen_arr)[:2]:  # 2 lowest
    ax1.annotate(f'L{idx}\n{qwen_arr[idx]:.3f}',
                 xy=(idx, qwen_arr[idx]), xytext=(0, -18),
                 textcoords='offset points', ha='center', fontsize=8,
                 color='#C0392B', fontweight='bold')

qwen_mean = qwen_arr.mean()
qwen_std = qwen_arr.std()
ax1.axhline(qwen_mean, color='#C0392B', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.6)
ax1.text(len(qwen_gates) - 1, qwen_mean + 0.008,
         f'mean = {qwen_mean:.3f} ± {qwen_std:.3f}',
         ha='right', fontsize=9, color='#C0392B', fontstyle='italic')

ax1.set_xlabel('Layer Index')
ax1.set_ylabel('Gate Value')
ax1.set_title('(a) Qwen-2.5-7B', pad=8)
ax1.set_xticks(range(0, len(qwen_gates), 2))
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'{i}' for i in range(0, len(qwen_gates), 2)])
ax1.set_ylim(0.68, 1.03)

# --- Llama subplot ---
x_l = np.arange(len(llama_gates))
bars_l = ax2.bar(x_l, llama_arr, color=COLOR_LLAMA, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3, width=0.8)

# Annotate min layers
for idx in np.argsort(llama_arr)[:3]:  # 3 lowest (V-shape valley)
    ax2.annotate(f'L{idx}\n{llama_arr[idx]:.3f}',
                 xy=(idx, llama_arr[idx]), xytext=(0, -18),
                 textcoords='offset points', ha='center', fontsize=8,
                 color='#C0392B', fontweight='bold')

llama_mean = llama_arr.mean()
llama_std = llama_arr.std()
ax2.axhline(llama_mean, color='#C0392B', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.6)
ax2.text(len(llama_gates) - 1, llama_mean + 0.008,
         f'mean = {llama_mean:.3f} ± {llama_std:.3f}',
         ha='right', fontsize=9, color='#C0392B', fontstyle='italic')

ax2.set_xlabel('Layer Index')
ax2.set_title('(b) Llama-3.1-8B', pad=8)
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, len(llama_gates), 2))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f'{i}' for i in range(0, len(llama_gates), 2)])

# Save
outdir = '/root/turn_residual_gating/artifacts'
import os
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_gate_profile_crossmodel.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_gate_profile_crossmodel.png')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved PDF and PNG to {outdir}/')
